title: Hierarchy & Selection
description: Organize your scene using parenting, searching, visibility toggles, and selection tricks.

slides.title: The Hierarchy Window 🌳
slides.content:
# Scene Organization

The Hierarchy shows every GameObject in the scene. You can:
- **Parent/Child**: Drag one object onto another to make it a child. The child follows the parent’s transform.
- **Sorting**: Objects can be reordered by dragging. The order doesn't affect rendering but helps organization.
- **Search**: Use the search bar (top‑right) to filter by name or component type.

quizData.question: How do you make one GameObject a child of another?

options.text: Drag it onto the parent in the Hierarchy
Copy and paste it inside the parent

quizData.explanation: Simply drag one object onto another in the Hierarchy to parent it.

slides.title: Visibility & Locking 👁️
slides.content:
# Eye and Lock Icons

- **Visibility toggle** (eye icon): Turns the object off in the Scene view (but it’s still active).
- **Lock toggle**: Prevents selection of the object in the Scene view (great for working on complex scenes).
- **Active toggle**: In the Inspector, you can deactivate a GameObject entirely (it disappears from game and scene).

quizData.question: What does the lock icon in the Hierarchy do?

options.text: Prevents the object from being deleted
Prevents accidental selection in the Scene view

quizData.explanation: The lock icon prevents you from selecting that GameObject in the Scene view, protecting it from accidental changes.

slides.title: Selection Tricks 🔍
slides.content:
# Efficient Selection

- **Multiple selection**: Hold **Ctrl** to add/remove objects to selection.
- **Select children**: Right‑click an object → **Select Children**.
- **Frame all**: Press **Shift+F** with nothing selected to frame the whole scene.
- **Scene picking**: Click directly in the Scene view to select objects (even hidden ones with the Selection Filter).

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use Empty GameObjects

Create empty GameObjects (GameObject > Create Empty) as folder‑like parents to organize your Hierarchy without visible geometry.
